source.version: Part 13 — Terpenes, Volatiles, and Other Secondary Metabolites — Batch 02
source.publicationAuthorization: Project owner authorized continued website publication on 2026-08-29. Independent specialist approval remains a separate project-control field and is not implied by publication.
source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-246–250 were reconciled against the controlled Volume 13 manuscript plus direct cannabis terpene-synthase, genome/profile, validated analytical-method, and postharvest-storage evidence. Public wording separates terpene concentration from cultivar labels, sensory descriptors, pharmacology, and clinical effects; preserves stereochemical and isomer distinctions where analytically relevant; and distinguishes relative percentage changes from absolute compound gain or loss.
source.note: This batch publishes the five major individual-terpene lessons: myrcene, limonene, alpha/beta-pinene, linalool, and beta-caryophyllene.
